ST-03.title: Enforce trade-plan linkage at position entry + DB-level safeguard against orphaned trade_plans rows

ST-03.notes: Resolved by Sprint Execution Engine acting as Head of Engineering (explicit user direction), per DEL-20260811-01's full resolution write-up in delegation_log.md. Router/service layer: POST /portfolio/position returns trade_plan_linked/trade_plan_id (portfolio_endpoints.md v2.6.0->v2.6.1). DB layer: trade_plans_active_requires_position_check CHECK constraint (NOT VALID, going-forward only) + router-level 400 guards in BOTH create_plan() and update_plan() (trade_plan_endpoints.md v0.9->v0.10); documented as data_model.md DS-12 (v2.24->v2.25). Agent-mediated Data Model Owner review: first pass NOT CONFIRMED (missing API contract version bumps + a POST /trade-plans coverage gap the reviewer found); both remediated in-session. DEVIATION, explicitly flagged not silently closed: staging verification of the entry-flow enforcement was NOT performed (no live staging/Postgres access in this sandbox) -- filed as BLG-BE-96 (elevated to P1, 2026-08-12) along with an unverified interaction between the new CHECK constraint and the 11 known legacy orphaned trade_plans rows. Condition attached: if BLG-BE-96's audit finds any of the 11 rows are status='active', that finding escalates to its own P0 immediately. ST-12.title: Multi-currency cost-basis rounding consistency check
ST-12.unblock_criteria: Audit complete (systematic, not just the starting-point finding); any inconsistency found is fixed (or documented as immaterial with a quantified bound); Financial Reporting & Records Owner sign-off recorded.
ST-12.notes: Resolved by Sprint Execution Engine acting as Head of Engineering (explicit user direction), per DEL-20260811-02's full resolution write-up in delegation_log.md. Systematic audit across all 3 named call sites found 2 findings. Finding 1 (entry-side US-vs-UK asymmetry) does not survive DB persistence -- documented as immaterial, no fix needed (criterion b). Finding 2 (partial-exit proportional cost allocation) was ORIGINALLY documented as bounded/non-compounding/immaterial, but that conclusion was WRONG -- a later agent-mediated dual review (Director of Quality + Product Owner) against the open PR produced a counter-example (37 exits of a £12,345.67 position, £0.12 drift, 6x the asserted bound) disproving it. FIXED (not just documented) in position_service.py::exit_position(): exit_total_cost/exit_entry_fees now round immediately, remaining_cost/remaining_fees derive by exact subtraction from the already-rounded starting values -- telescopes to zero drift for any share count/position size/exit count, verified against the exact counter-example. docs/product/decisions/multi-currency-cost-basis-rounding-audit--2026-08-12.md and tests/test_multi_currency_cost_basis_rounding_audit.py (now 8 tests) both revised. Full backend suite (1071 tests) green post-fix. Process note: the FIRST agent-mediated FRRO review (pre-PR) claimed to have independently re-verified the bound and found it conservative -- that claim was itself unsubstantiated and did not catch the real bug; only a second, independently-scoped review pass caught it. See delegation_log.md's Correction entry for the full account.
